title: 15 Days Online Yoga Philosophy Course
metaDescription: Discover ancient yoga philosophy in 15 days. Explore mindfulness, self-discovery & timeless teachings online. Perfect for all levels.
summary: This 15-day online yoga philosophy course mixes prerecorded videos and daily 1-hour live Zoom classes with teachers from Rishikesh, India.
intro: This 15-day online yoga philosophy course mixes prerecorded videos and daily 1-hour live Zoom classes with teachers from Rishikesh, India. You'll learn the true meaning of yoga—not just poses, but the deeper ideas behind it, like why yoga practices work and how they can improve your daily life.
During live classes, ask questions, dive deeper into topics, and even practice sharing what you learn with others.
